findings.conclusion: Projection receives CodexRemoteThreadListGrouping and TaskSection.Item. Four-way dispatch is raw0/2 to0x3373cc, raw1 to0x337494 and raw3 to0x3375cc. Metadata names priority/byWorkspaces/chronological/byRemoteHost in that order. Name-to-tag mapping remains an ABI-based inference pending an explicit producer/raw-value check.

Working-directory branch reads CodexRemoteTaskListItem metadata slot+0x50, bound to workingDirectoryPath, not title or projectID. Nil second word goes to No workspace label; nonnil path uses string predicate0xf87cc before continuing. Full string-predicate semantics remain unresolved, so whitespace policy is not asserted.

A specific host representation with tag byte2 and zero payload bypasses no-workspace handling and calls Recents constructor. Host metadata includes slingshot/ssh/cloud; this branch matches the no-payload cloud representation. Host-kind construction remains independently version-bound.

A nonempty-path branch may also enter Recents if0x2acd760 returns true. That predicate examines path components including Codex and Documents and additional component/count checks. Its full accepted path grammar is unresolved. Thus nil project/workspace alone cannot reproduce Recents membership.

Constructor input is CodexRemoteHostIdentity, proven by copy helper metadata descriptor0x95d1538. It constructs a new-thread target from this host and zero-initialized directory/project storage. It does not simply copy a fully supplied new-thread target. This refines the v497 description.

Two additional Recents calls occur in the larger section producer. One follows host inclusion helper0x2d1644 and a nil projectID read at metadata+0x58. The second uses a host candidate collection and existing-section checks. Their host arbitration/merging policy is unresolved; do not choose first or active host based on screenshots.

Recents descriptor ID is empty-case payload2/tag6. It reaches common header and selects kind2. Pinned selects kind0. Existing header evidence shows kind2 uses expanded-chevron fade behavior, so the two headers cannot share all presentation flags.
Recents supplies no project folder icon and has a host-scoped new-thread target. New button routing must retain this target separately from displayed title and global section identity.
